items.prompt: Why should a strategy not treat the last price as current after a sequence gap?
items.modelAnswer: Missing events can change book/price/size/state and local history is only last contiguous/stale. Preserve expected/observed session/ranges and pause current-state use; recover coherent snapshot/replay under the source protocol, validate and reconcile before resuming. A visible number/checksum/heartbeat alone is not completeness or trading authority.

criteria.text: Names stale/partial state from missing events.
Requires explicit coherent recovery and validation.
Keeps display/transport success separate from current-state trust.
